unreachable: No hub answers at this address. Check the address, that the hub is on and that you are on the same Wi-Fi.
intro: Connect to your device. Direct — by its IP on your network; Via broker — remotely over MQTT.
introHub: Connect to a hub by its IP address on your network.
brokerInfo: Remote access via an MQTT broker (requires a wss listener on the broker).
hostHelp: Find the hub's address in your router's device list, or use rbgrid-xxxx.local — the same four characters as the hub's own Wi-Fi name (not on every Android phone). Your phone or computer must be on the same Wi-Fi.
localNetworkHint: If the browser asked whether this site may access devices on your local network, allow it (site settings → Local network access).
